records.translation: tropical_island_day_ambient/-1000 -100/farmer 20 48 1/skippable/pause 1000/viewport 21 47 true/pause 1000/playSound thudStep/addTemporaryActor SafariGuy 16 32 22 45 2 true ???/move SafariGuy 0 3 3/pause 1000/speak SafariGuy "謝謝你！我以為自己死定了…… $h#$b#我被困在這個洞穴好幾個月了！"/pause 500/faceDirection SafariGuy 2/pause 300/showFrame SafariGuy 16/pause 600/emote SafariGuy 28/speak SafariGuy "……再吃一份洞穴蘑菇沙拉，我就要發瘋了……*顫抖*……簡直像橡膠一樣……$s"/pause 500/showFrame SafariGuy 0/pause 500/faceDirection SafariGuy 3/pause 500/translateName SafariGuy Strings\NPCNames:ProfessorSnail/speak SafariGuy "總之……我是蝸牛教授。#$b#過去一年，我一直在調查這座島的動植物。這地方真是非比尋常！"/pause 400/faceDirection SafariGuy 2/pause 250/faceDirection SafariGuy 3/speak SafariGuy "嗯，我想我該回帳篷稍微梳洗一下。恐怕我渾身都是蘑菇味……$s#$b#嘿……有空來帳篷坐坐！像你這麼有進取心的人，說不定能為我的研究帶來很大助益……嘿嘿！再會。$h"/pause 200/showFrame SafariGuy 17/pause 800/showFrame SafariGuy 12/pause 200/advancedMove SafariGuy true 1 0 0 4/pause 250/end position 20 48

records.source: fieldofficeTentMusic/-1000 -1000/farmer 4 10 0/skippable/addTemporaryActor SafariGuy 16 32 5 4 0 true character/translateName SafariGuy Strings\NPCNames:ProfessorSnail/viewport 4 6 true/move farmer 0 -2 0/pause 1000/faceDirection SafariGuy 1 true/pause 50/faceDirection SafariGuy 2 true/pause 500/speak SafariGuy "Ah... Come in!"/move farmer 2 0 0/move farmer 0 -4 3/faceDirection SafariGuy 1/pause 500/speak SafariGuy "Welcome to my field office."/faceDirection SafariGuy 2/faceDirection farmer 2/showFrame SafariGuy 16/emote SafariGuy 28/pause 500/speak SafariGuy "As you can see... it's quite empty.$s#$b#Getting stuck in that cave was a huge setback to my project.$s"/pause 50/showFrame SafariGuy 0/pause 200/faceDirection SafariGuy 1/pause 100/speak SafariGuy "But that's where you come in! Hee hee...$h"/faceDirection farmer 3/emote farmer 8/speak SafariGuy "I'm in the bone business, you see...#$b#Ancient bones, in particular... And this island is full of them.#$b#So if you ever encounter any bones, fossils, or mummified specimens on this island, bring them to my desk, okay? I'll make it worth your while!$h"/pause 200/faceDirection SafariGuy 1/end
records.translation: fieldofficeTentMusic/-1000 -1000/farmer 4 10 0/skippable/addTemporaryActor SafariGuy 16 32 5 4 0 true character/translateName SafariGuy Strings\NPCNames:ProfessorSnail/viewport 4 6 true/move farmer 0 -2 0/pause 1000/faceDirection SafariGuy 1 true/pause 50/faceDirection SafariGuy 2 true/pause 500/speak SafariGuy "啊……請進！"/move farmer 2 0 0/move farmer 0 -4 3/faceDirection SafariGuy 1/pause 500/speak SafariGuy "歡迎來到我的野外辦公室。"/faceDirection SafariGuy 2/faceDirection farmer 2/showFrame SafariGuy 16/emote SafariGuy 28/pause 500/speak SafariGuy "如你所見……這裡空蕩蕩的。$s#$b#被困在那個洞穴，讓我的研究遭受了重大挫折。$s"/pause 50/showFrame SafariGuy 0/pause 200/faceDirection SafariGuy 1/pause 100/speak SafariGuy "但這正是你能派上用場的地方！嘿嘿……$h"/faceDirection farmer 3/emote farmer 8/speak SafariGuy "你瞧，我是研究骨頭的……#$b#尤其是古代骨骼……而這座島到處都是。#$b#所以你若在島上發現任何骨頭、化石或木乃伊化的標本，就帶到我的桌上，好嗎？我不會讓你白忙的！$h"/pause 200/faceDirection SafariGuy 1/end

records.translation: continue/-1000 -1000/farmer 7 7 3/skippable/specificTemporarySprite removeSprite 777/addTemporaryActor ParrotBoy 16 32 5 2 2 true ???/pause 2000/viewport 5 7 true/pause 2000/emote ParrotBoy 8/pause 1500/message "男孩用好奇的眼神看著你……"/pause 1500/animate ParrotBoy false true 500 17 0/playSound parrot_squawk/pause 1000/playSound parrot_squawk/pause 800/stopAnimation ParrotBoy/specificTemporarySprite parrotHutSquawk/pause 800/move farmer -2 0 0/pause 500/emote farmer 8/pause 1000/message "他似乎與鸚鵡感情深厚。"/pause 500/message "但他現在太害羞，不敢接近你。"/pause 1400/faceDirection farmer 1/pause 500/message "也許和鸚鵡成為朋友，就能贏得他的信任？"/pause 1000/end position 5 7

records.source: tropical_island_day_ambient/-1000 -1000/farmer 20 58 3/skippable/addTemporaryActor Birdie 32 32 17 58 3 true ???/animate Birdie false true 1000 8 9/pause 1000/viewport 18 58 clamp true/pause 1000/emote Birdie 8/pause 1000/speak Birdie "Oh... a visitor?#$b#Come closer, child."/pause 400/move farmer -1 0 3/pause 300/emote Birdie 40/speak Birdie "I haven't had a visitor in many moons...$s#$b#I almost forgot what other people looked like!"/pause 1000/speak Birdie "Well, I suppose now that you're here, I may as well ask you for a favor."/pause 500/textAboveHead Birdie "Come..."/pause 500/playFramesAhead 3/stopAnimation Birdie/extendSourceRect Birdie reset/warp Birdie 18 58/viewport move 1 0 2000/move Birdie 0 -1 2/move Birdie 2 0 1/move farmer 1 0 1/pause 500/speak Birdie "Have you seen that wrecked ship on the south shore?#$b# My husband was the captain. A pirate, he was.#$b#He set sail one day, never to return. Took me three years sailing the high seas to find his remains.$s"/emote Birdie 28/speak Birdie "*sigh*...$s#$b#I've been here ever since, dear.$s#$b#...Guarding his bones..."/faceDirection farmer 2 true/playSound batScreech/animate farmer false true 100 94/jump farmer/pause 1500/stopAnimation farmer/faceDirection farmer 0/faceDirection Birdie 2/speak Birdie "My child... If I could only find a keepsake of his, it would bring me such peace.$s"/pause 400/textAboveHead Birdie "Wait here..."/move Birdie -1 0 0/move Birdie 0 -1 3/warp Birdie -100 -100/playSound doorClose/faceDirection farmer 0/faceDirection Birdie 2/pause 1000/playSound Ship/pause 1000/playSound Ship/playSound crafting/pause 1000/playSound doorClose/warp Birdie 20 56/move Birdie 0 1 2/speak Birdie "Here, take this. It's an old photograph that washed up on shore.#$b#It's all I have to offer... but somehow, I think it will help you find what I seek."/pause 500/unskippable/playSound coin/awardFestivalPrize memento true/pause 10/addQuest 130/pause 1700/end
records.translation: tropical_island_day_ambient/-1000 -1000/farmer 20 58 3/skippable/addTemporaryActor Birdie 32 32 17 58 3 true ???/animate Birdie false true 1000 8 9/pause 1000/viewport 18 58 clamp true/pause 1000/emote Birdie 8/pause 1000/speak Birdie "噢……有訪客嗎？#$b#靠近一點，孩子。"/pause 400/move farmer -1 0 3/pause 300/emote Birdie 40/speak Birdie "我已經好多個月沒見過訪客了……$s#$b#我差點忘了其他人長什麼樣子！"/pause 1000/speak Birdie "既然你來了，我想不妨請你幫個忙。"/pause 500/textAboveHead Birdie "過來……"/pause 500/playFramesAhead 3/stopAnimation Birdie/extendSourceRect Birdie reset/warp Birdie 18 58/viewport move 1 0 2000/move Birdie 0 -1 2/move Birdie 2 0 1/move farmer 1 0 1/pause 500/speak Birdie "你看見南岸那艘失事船隻了嗎？#$b#我丈夫是船長。他是個海盜。#$b#某天他揚帆出海，從此再也沒有回來。我花了三年航行於大海，才找到他的遺骸。$s"/emote Birdie 28/speak Birdie "*嘆氣*……$s#$b#親愛的，從那之後我就一直待在這裡。$s#$b#……守著他的骨骸……"/faceDirection farmer 2 true/playSound batScreech/animate farmer false true 100 94/jump farmer/pause 1500/stopAnimation farmer/faceDirection farmer 0/faceDirection Birdie 2/speak Birdie "孩子……要是能找到一件他的紀念物，一定能讓我的心得到安寧。$s"/pause 400/textAboveHead Birdie "在這裡等著……"/move Birdie -1 0 0/move Birdie 0 -1 3/warp Birdie -100 -100/playSound doorClose/faceDirection farmer 0/faceDirection Birdie 2/pause 1000/playSound Ship/pause 1000/playSound Ship/playSound crafting/pause 1000/playSound doorClose/warp Birdie 20 56/move Birdie 0 1 2/speak Birdie "來，拿著。這是一張被沖上岸的老照片。#$b#這是我唯一能給你的東西……但不知怎的，我覺得它能幫你找到我要的東西。"/pause 500/unskippable/playSound coin/awardFestivalPrize memento true/pause 10/addQuest 130/pause 1700/end

records.source: tropical_island_day_ambient/-1000 -1000/farmer 20 58 3/removeQuest 130/skippable/addTemporaryActor Birdie 32 32 17 58 3 true/animate Birdie false true 1000 8 9/pause 1000/viewport 18 58 clamp true/pause 2300/playMusic none/animate farmer true true 100 35/addObject 19 58 870/playSound sandyStep/pause 800/stopAnimation farmer/playFramesAhead 3/stopAnimation Birdie/extendSourceRect Birdie reset/warp Birdie 18 58/move Birdie 0 -1 2/move Birdie 1 0 2/pause 500/jump Birdie/pause 500/playMusic desolate/speak Birdie "It's his...$s"/emote Birdie 20/pause 1200/playSound coin/removeObject 19 58/showFrame Birdie 20/pause 2500/speak Birdie "Heh... It still has his smell, after all these years...#$b#...that familiar, putrid funk...$h"/pause 300/faceDirection farmer 2 true/playSound croak/animate farmer false false 350 104 105 104 105 104 105/pause 1000/faceDirection farmer 3/speak Birdie "You know... It's been a lonely life here, child... but I don't regret it at all.#$b#I'm doin' right by my old man... and we'll be together again some day soon... hehe"/pause 500/stopAnimation Birdie/move Birdie 0 1 3/playMusic tropical_island_day_ambient/faceDirection Birdie 1/quickQuestion #It's an honorable thing to do.#He's gone. You should live your life.(break)speak Birdie "You have great wisdom, child.#$b#And you've brought me great peace... this locket will comfort me for the rest of my days.$h"(break)emote Birdie 28\speak Birdie "An old woman like me? I think it's too late, dear...$s#$b#Besides... I like it here! It's relaxing and beautiful. And I have an endless supply of fresh fish, oysters, and monkey meat. Hehehe.$h#$b#...I'm kidding about the monkey meat."/pause 1000/speak Birdie "Now... how can I repay you for this?"/jump Birdie/pause 500/speak Birdie "Oh... How about I teach you a special recipe... Something I discovered in the many years I've spent here."/pause 1000/playSound reward/addCraftingRecipe Fairy Dust/message "Learned to craft 'Fairy Dust'."/pause 1000/fork gotBirdieReward Strings\\Locations:alreadyGotNuts true/speak Birdie "You can take these, too..."/awardFestivalPrize birdieReward true/pause 1000/speak Birdie "Though you're a stranger, you went out of your way to help an old lady.#$b#Bless your heart!$h"/emote Birdie 20/emote farmer 32/pause 1000/end
records.translation: tropical_island_day_ambient/-1000 -1000/farmer 20 58 3/removeQuest 130/skippable/addTemporaryActor Birdie 32 32 17 58 3 true/animate Birdie false true 1000 8 9/pause 1000/viewport 18 58 clamp true/pause 2300/playMusic none/animate farmer true true 100 35/addObject 19 58 870/playSound sandyStep/pause 800/stopAnimation farmer/playFramesAhead 3/stopAnimation Birdie/extendSourceRect Birdie reset/warp Birdie 18 58/move Birdie 0 -1 2/move Birdie 1 0 2/pause 500/jump Birdie/pause 500/playMusic desolate/speak Birdie "是他的……$s"/emote Birdie 20/pause 1200/playSound coin/removeObject 19 58/showFrame Birdie 20/pause 2500/speak Birdie "呵……這麼多年過去，上面仍有他的氣味……#$b#……那股熟悉又腐臭的怪味……$h"/pause 300/faceDirection farmer 2 true/playSound croak/animate farmer false false 350 104 105 104 105 104 105/pause 1000/faceDirection farmer 3/speak Birdie "你知道嗎……孩子，我在這裡的生活很孤獨……但我一點也不後悔。#$b#我對得起我家老伴……總有一天，我們很快又會團聚……呵呵"/pause 500/stopAnimation Birdie/move Birdie 0 1 3/playMusic tropical_island_day_ambient/faceDirection Birdie 1/quickQuestion #這麼做很高尚。#他已經不在了。你該過自己的人生。(break)speak Birdie "孩子，你很有智慧。#$b#而且你為我帶來了莫大的安寧……這枚墜飾將陪伴我度過餘生。$h"(break)emote Birdie 28\speak Birdie "像我這樣的老太婆？親愛的，恐怕太遲了……$s#$b#更何況……我喜歡這裡！既悠閒又美麗，還有取之不盡的新鮮魚、牡蠣和猴肉。呵呵呵。$h#$b#……猴肉是開玩笑的。"/pause 1000/speak Birdie "那麼……我該怎麼報答你？"/jump Birdie/pause 500/speak Birdie "噢……不如我教你一道特別的配方……這是我在此生活多年後發現的。"/pause 1000/playSound reward/addCraftingRecipe Fairy Dust/message "學會製作「仙塵」。"/pause 1000/fork gotBirdieReward Strings\\Locations:alreadyGotNuts true/speak Birdie "這些也拿去吧……"/awardFestivalPrize birdieReward true/pause 1000/speak Birdie "儘管你我素不相識，你卻特地幫助我這個老太婆。#$b#真是好心的孩子！$h"/emote Birdie 20/emote farmer 32/pause 1000/end

records.source: distantBanjo/-1000 -1000/farmer 4 8 0/addCraftingRecipe Ostrich Incubator/addMailReceived fieldOfficeFinale/skippable/addTemporaryActor SafariGuy 16 32 3 8 0 true character/translateName SafariGuy Strings\NPCNames:ProfessorSnail/pause 1000/viewport 4 6 true/pause 4000/speak SafariGuy "Wow...#$b#Look how far we've come!$h"/faceDirection SafariGuy 1/speak SafariGuy "The collection looks fantastic, and it's all thanks to you, @."/emote farmer 32/speak SafariGuy "Here, as a way of saying 'thanks', I want to teach you something."/faceDirection farmer 3/pause 700/playSound reward/message "Learned how to craft 'Ostrich Incubator'"/pause 400/speak SafariGuy "This device will allow you to raise ostriches back home. Just place the incubator in a barn, place an ostrich egg inside, and wait..."/faceDirection SafariGuy 0/speak SafariGuy "Getting your hands on an ostrich egg is a different story, though... I'll leave that up to you!"/pause 400/faceDirection farmer 0/pause 500/speak SafariGuy "Heh... Well... now the real work begins.#$b#I'll be studying these bones for years to come!"/faceDirection SafariGuy 1/faceDirection farmer 3/speak SafariGuy "Farewell, @!"/pause 600/end
records.translation: distantBanjo/-1000 -1000/farmer 4 8 0/addCraftingRecipe Ostrich Incubator/addMailReceived fieldOfficeFinale/skippable/addTemporaryActor SafariGuy 16 32 3 8 0 true character/translateName SafariGuy Strings\NPCNames:ProfessorSnail/pause 1000/viewport 4 6 true/pause 4000/speak SafariGuy "哇……#$b#瞧瞧我們有多大的進展！$h"/faceDirection SafariGuy 1/speak SafariGuy "收藏看起來太棒了，這全都要感謝你，@。"/emote farmer 32/speak SafariGuy "來，為了表達謝意，我想教你一樣東西。"/faceDirection farmer 3/pause 700/playSound reward/message "學會製作「鴕鳥孵化器」。"/pause 400/speak SafariGuy "這台裝置能讓你回家飼養鴕鳥。只要把孵化器放進畜棚，再放入一顆鴕鳥蛋，然後等待……"/faceDirection SafariGuy 0/speak SafariGuy "不過，弄到鴕鳥蛋又是另一回事……這就交給你了！"/pause 400/faceDirection farmer 0/pause 500/speak SafariGuy "呵……好啦……真正的工作現在才要開始。#$b#這些骨頭夠我研究好多年！"/faceDirection SafariGuy 1/faceDirection farmer 3/speak SafariGuy "再會，@！"/pause 600/end

records.source: The town's 'Lost and Found' box. You can collect incomplete deliveries from past special orders here.
records.translation: 鎮上的「失物招領」箱。你可以在這裡領回過往特別訂單中未完成交付的物品。

records.source: Collect lost items and incomplete deliveries
records.translation: 領取失物與未完成交付的物品
取回離線農場幫手的物品

records.source: Who would you like to retrieve items from?
records.translation: 你想取回哪位玩家的物品？

records.source: Ah... Now this is a truly fascinating piece of natural history! Thank you.
records.translation: 啊……這真是一件令人著迷的自然史標本！謝謝你。

records.source: Beautiful! These bones are exactly what I'm looking for. Now, let me clean my magnifying lens...
records.translation: 太美了！這些骨頭正是我要找的。現在，讓我先擦乾淨放大鏡……

records.source: You've outdone yourself, @. This is one of the most pristine specimens I've ever seen. Thank you!$h
records.translation: 你真是超越了自己，@。這是我見過保存最完好的標本之一。謝謝你！$h

records.source: To think... generations have come and gone while this little bone lay hidden beneath the soil. Now it's mine!
records.translation: 想想看……這塊小骨頭埋藏在土壤下時，世間已歷經好幾個世代。現在它歸我了！

records.source: And would you look at that! With this donation, we've got another full set piece completed.$h#$b#I've got a little something waiting for you behind the counter, when you're ready for it!
records.translation: 快瞧瞧！有了這件捐贈品，我們又完成了一整組收藏。$h#$b#我在櫃檯後面準備了一點東西，等你準備好就來拿吧！

records.source: Take the shortcut out of the volcano?
